title: Ciel read-only manifest v1
$comment: Executable offline parser contract. Shape validation does not establish file authority, readiness, secret validity or runtime admission.

deployment_generation.description: Administrator-issued opaque revision, not a timestamp, live pass or activation grant.

owner_file.description: Protected exact canonical owner identity; never a model-supplied actor.

registry_file.description: Registered Workspace grants validated with the shared Rust read-only rules.

core_token_file.description: Business bearer reference; no token value appears in this manifest.

operator_token_file.description: Separate operator-only recovery bearer, never provided to Gateway.

google_credentials_file.description: Service-account credential reference; offline inspection never opens its body.

state_directory.description: Existing private service-owned operational directory, not a personal/source store.

release_file.description: Immutable release inventory; artifact consistency is not service qualification.

service_policy_file.description: Protected service-identity, filesystem, loopback and launcher policy.

budget_policy_file.description: Required processing-policy reference. Its unresolved schema/accounting contract blocks complete admission.

absolutePath.description: Absolute Linux deployment path using ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens. No root-only path, empty/dot component, trailing slash, expansion or URI. Filesystem safety requires separate descriptor/ancestor checks.
